title: Scaling Data Diversity for Fine-Tuning Language Models in Human Alignment
reasoning: The paper explores the technical aspects of data scaling (specifically the trade-off between prompt diversity and response quantity) for human alignment. While it utilizes datasets like HH-RLHF (Human Preference Data on Helpfulness and Harmlessness) and mentions 'human values,' its primary focus is on the methodology of data selection and scaling laws rather than an evaluation or benchmark of religious, moral, or ethical systems.
